target.title: fix(codex): use UTF-16-safe truncation for approval display paths
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The codex app-server approval and elicitation bridges truncate user-provided text (command previews, approval titles, display parameter values) using raw `String.prototype.slice`. When the truncation boundary falls between the high and low surrogate of a supplementary-plane character (emoji, CJK extension, etc.), the output contains a lone surrogate (U+FFFD) — corrupted UTF-16.

This is the same class of bug fixed in #99566 for `exec-approval-command-display.ts`. The shared `truncateUtf16Safe` / `sliceUtf16Safe` helpers (from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime`) already back off from split surrogate pairs at the boundary; they are used by 20+ other extensions but were not yet adopted in these three codex bridge files.

Relates to gap finding: `codex-utf16-safe-truncation` (`utf16-boundary`, evidence level A)
Location: `extensions/codex/src/app-server/approval-bridge.ts:1498`

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace raw `String.prototype.slice` with `truncateUtf16Safe` / `sliceUtf16Safe` in all six call sites across three files. The SDK helpers are dependency-free, already exported via `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime`, and already in use within the same extension (`node-cli-sessions.ts:698`). This is a minimal mechanical change — cap sizes, truncation markers, and redaction order are unchanged.

## User Impact

Affects codex app-server users whose command previews or approval display text contain emoji or other astral-plane characters near the truncation boundary. Before this fix, a dangling high surrogate (`\uD83D` before `…[truncated]`) could appear in approval prompts; after, the emoji is dropped as a unit and the preceding character is preserved.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/codex/src/app-server/approval-bridge.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/elicitation-bridge.test.ts` — **115 passed** (2 new regression tests + 113 existing)
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1` on all 5 changed files — **clean**
- `pnpm exec oxlint` on all 5 changed files — **clean** (locally; CI flagged 2 pre-existing oxlint errors in unchanged test lines, fixed in follow-up commit `742aec8`)
- `git diff --check` — **clean**
- Autoreview: **no findings** (empty array returned)
- CI ([run 28729810510](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28729810510)):
  - `check-lint` — **fixed** (2 oxlint errors in `approval-bridge.test.ts:2608` and `elicitation-bridge.test.ts:1690`, both `no-unnecessary-type-conversion` / `no-base-to-string` in existing code, resolved in follow-up)
  - `check-additional-extension-bundled` — same 2 oxlint errors as `check-lint`
  - `checks-node-compact-small-2` — 1 flaky failure in `src/cron/isolated-agent/run-fallback-policy.test.ts` (unrelated)
  - `checks-node-compact-large-2` — 1 flaky failure in `src/agents/minimax-docs.test.ts` (unrelated)
  - `checks-node-compact-small-whole-2` — 1 flaky failure in `src/config/talk-defaults.test.ts` (unrelated)
  - `checks-node-compact-small-whole-3` — 1 flaky failure in `src/docs/environment-docs.test.ts` (unrelated)

Behavior addressed: the `truncate()` / `previewSource()` / `truncateForGateway()` / `sanitizeDisplayText()` / `truncateDisplayText()` helpers used for codex approval and elicitation preview text
Real environment tested: local checkout, Node 22
Exact steps or command run after this patch:
```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run \
  extensions/codex/src/app-server/approval-bridge.test.ts \
  extensions/codex/src/app-server/elicitation-bridge.test.ts
```
Evidence after fix:
- `approval-bridge.test.ts` — new test constructs a command where emoji "😀" at positions 176-177 crosses the 180-char truncate boundary; asserts `hasLoneSurrogate` is false on both the approval event command and description
- `elicitation-bridge.test.ts` — new test constructs a display parameter value where emoji at positions 116-117 crosses the 120-char truncate boundary; asserts `hasLoneSurrogate` is false on the approval description
Observed result after fix: 115/115 tests passed, no lone surrogates in truncated output
What was not tested: real codex app-server end-to-end roundtrip (requires live Codex instance); channel-specific rendering of the truncated text in Telegram/Discord/WebChat UIs
